proto: Prototype · 4 of ~40 bills · texts, tallies and excerpts are illustrative drafts, not verified
absentNote: {x} of 120 members did not vote. We treat absence as missing data, never as abstention.
sidedNone: No faction’s majority voted like you.
soFarEmpty: Vote on a bill to see where you would sit.
basedOn: Based on {n} votes · bars show the 90% range
historic: This compares your answers with how 25th-Knesset factions actually voted. It is a record of the past, not a prediction of what any 2026 list will do.
newLists: Lists made up mostly of new candidates have little or no record in this Knesset, so we can’t match them. Your match with them is unknown — not zero.
sepNone: None of the remaining bills separates these two. Your answers so far put them level.
keepVoting: Keep voting to narrow the range
membersB: Members of the same faction almost always vote together, so we match parties first. Member-level matches unlock after {k} votes ({n} so far).
privacy: Your votes are stored only on this device. No account, no tracking.
sourcesNote: Sample sources — in the full app each links to the original document.
fallback: The long-form analysis is published in Hebrew and English for now. The {l} version is waiting for native-speaker review, so it is shown in English.
corrections: Reader corrections: coming in a later version.
done: That’s every bill in this prototype.
doneB: The full app would continue with the next most informative of ~40 hand-checked bills.
queueNote: Bills that would split your current top matches rise. Bills that repeat a split you’ve already answered sink.
algo: {ig} bits expected · salience {s}/10 · {o}% overlap with bills you answered
toastEnd: Recorded. Party votes are revealed in your results.
settingBlind: Hide the sponsor until I vote
